prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, three-quarter-length demi statue portrait, a 12-cell grid body (6 rows, two columns), every cell a genuinely different material, every seam physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh tips right at the knee, where the leg would bend, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Filipina woman in pageant glam makeup — warm tan skin, heavy sculpted contour and a glowing highlighter on the cheekbones, smoky bronze and gold glitter eyeshadow, dramatic long lashes, defined dark brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy coral-red lips, long voluminous chestnut waves, a bright, confident pageant smile. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a bright beaded drop earring.

Physique: A colossal heavy chest, a cinched waist above a big soft rounded belly and enormous round hips, body divided into a 12-cell grid (6 rows, two columns), each cell a different material, stepped seams.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow.

Below the collarbones, her body is divided into a grid of 12 cells — 6 horizontal rows crossed by one vertical centre line — each cell with a raised stepped edge and shadow at every border, no gaps, no skin anywhere. Row 1 (her whole left arm and left chest / her whole right arm and right chest): left cell solid transparent milky precious opal; right cell solid transparent orange-red carnelian. Row 2 (left / right body band 2): left cell carved solid vivid sky-blue turquoise with dark matrix veining, completely opaque; right cell carved solid banded green malachite with concentric rings, completely opaque. Row 3 (left / right body band 3): left cell carved solid deep grey labradorite that flashes blue-green light, completely opaque; right cell carved solid bright blue-green amazonite streaked with white feldspar, completely opaque. Row 4 (left / right body band 4): left cell carved solid banded black and white onyx, completely opaque; right cell carved solid deep royal-blue lapis lazuli with golden pyrite flecks, completely opaque. Row 5 (left / right body band 5): left cell carved solid polished black obsidian with faint internal swirls, completely opaque; right cell carved solid white Carrara marble veined with soft grey streaks, completely opaque. Row 6 (left thigh-stub tip / right thigh-stub tip (right at the knee, where the leg would bend)): left cell carved solid golden-brown tiger's eye with a silky chatoyant band, completely opaque, rounding off at its tip; right cell carved solid deep blue sodalite with fine white veining, completely opaque, rounding off at its tip.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a soft mint on one side and a warm terracotta on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so mint light glances off one side and terracotta light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam in the grid. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
